==Religion==
The term '''Hachiōji''' (八王子) refers to the eight {{ill|Ōji-no-Kami|ja|王子神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11573000}} or their {{ill|Retinue (religion)|ja|眷属|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11583697}}, or shrines that enshrine them.<ref name="koj">''{{ill|Kōjien|en|Kōjien|qid=Q1192611|lt=Kōjien}}'' Fifth Edition, entry "Hachiōji"</ref> alternate_name include Dai-Hachiōji, Hachidaiōji, Hachininōji, and Hachidaidōji. Originally a Buddhist term, it was transmitted to Shinto through {{ill|Shinbutsu-shūgō|en|Shinbutsu-shūgō|qid=Q2279088|lt=Shinbutsu-shūgō}}.<ref name="kokushi">''{{ill|National History Encyclopedia|ja|国史大辞典|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q6426904}}'' p.586, entry "Hachiōji"</ref>
* {{ill|Hachiōji Gongen|ja|八王子権現|qid=Q11391615}}: The eight sons of {{ill|Gozu Tennō|en|Gozu Tennō|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō}} in {{ill|Gion Faith|en|Gion cult|qid=Q11588425|lt=Gion faith}}<ref name="koj"/>.
* The five male and three female deities who appeared during the {{ill|Five Male and Three Female Deities|ja|アマテラスとスサノオの誓約|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11284880}}<ref name="koj"/>. In the {{ill|Honji suijaku|en|Honji suijaku|qid=Q3080781|lt=honji suijaku}} theory, they were identified with Hachiōji Gongen, leading to changes in the {{ill|Changes to deities in the Meiji period|ja|祭神の変更|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11591102}}.
* The fourth shrine among the seven {{ill|Sannō|ja|山王|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11470026}} shrines of {{ill|Mount Hiei|en|Mount Hiei|qid=Q748040|lt=Mount Hiei}}<ref name="koj"/>.
* The eight sons born before the renunciation of {{ill|Nichigatsu Tōmyō Butsu|ja|日月灯明仏}}, one of the 20,000 {{ill|Sun and Moon Light Buddha|ja|日月燈明佛|qid=Q51418777}}<ref>Also written as {{ill|日月燈明佛|ja|日月燈明佛|qid=Q51418777}} or {{ill|日月燈明仏|ja|日月燈明仏}}</ref><ref name="koj"/>.

==Place Names==
* {{ill|Hachiōji (disambiguation)|ja|八王子|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11391544}} – A city in Tokyo Metropolis.
** {{ill|Moto-Hachiōjimachi|ja|元八王子町|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11387784}} – Location of {{ill|Hachiōji Shrine|ja|八王子神社 (八王子市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q132042040}} (formerly Hachiōji Gongen), the origin of the name of {{ill|Hachiōji Castle|en|Hachiōji Castle|qid=Q2969389|lt=Hachiōji Castle}}, from which the city name is also derived.
** The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism's transport bureau symbol as shown on vehicle {{ill|Vehicle registration plates of Japan|en|Vehicle registration plates of Japan|qid=Q1442604|lt=Japanese license plates}}. It refers to the {{ill|Tokyo Transport Bureau|ja|八王子自動車検査登録事務所|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 東京運輸支局|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11525180}} of the {{ill|Tokyo Transport Bureau|ja|東京運輸支局|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11525180}}, serving Hachiōji, {{ill|Ōme, Tokyo|en|Ōme, Tokyo|qid=Q237683|lt=Ōme, Tokyo}}, {{ill|Hino, Tokyo|en|Hino, Tokyo|qid=Q236197|lt=Hino}}, {{ill|Fussa, Tokyo|en|Fussa, Tokyo|qid=Q317813|lt=Fussa}}, {{ill|Hamura, Tokyo|en|Hamura, Tokyo|qid=Q270465|lt=Hamura}}, {{ill|Akiruno, Tokyo|en|Akiruno, Tokyo|qid=Q240480|lt=Akiruno}}, and {{ill|Nishitama District|en|Nishitama District, Tokyo|qid=Q1048689|lt=Nishitama District}}.
* {{ill|Hachiōji Hills|ja|八王子丘陵|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q55528405}} – A ridge stretching northwest to southeast from {{ill|Kiryū, Gunma|en|Kiryū, Gunma|qid=Q634022|lt=Kiryū}} to {{ill|Ōta, Gunma|ar|أوتا (غونما)|azb|اوتا، قونما|be|Ота (Японія)|bg|Ота|ce|Ота (гӀала, Япон)|ceb|Ōta-shi (distrito sa Hapon)|cs|Óta (Gunma)|de|Ōta (Gunma)|eo|Ōta (Gunma)|es|Ōta (Gunma)|et|Ōta|eu|Ōta (Gunma)|fa|اوتا، گونما|fi|Ōta (Gunma)|fr|Ōta (Gunma)|ga|Ōta|gl|Ōta, Gunma|id|Ōta, Gunma|it|Ōta (Gunma)|ja|太田市|kk|Ота (қала, Жапония)|ko|오타시|mg|Ōta|mn|Ота|mzn|اوتا، گونما|nl|Ota (Gunma)|no|Ōta (Gunma)|pl|Ōta|pt|Ōta (Gunma)|ro|Ōta, Gunma|ru|Ота (Япония)|sh|Ōta, Gunma|simple|Ōta, Gunma|sr|Ота|sv|Ōta, Gunma|szl|Ōta|tg|Ота|th|โอตะ (เมือง)|tl|Ota, Gunma|tr|Ōta, Gunma|tt|Ота (шәһәр, Япония)|uk|Ота (Ґумма)|ur|اوتا، گونما|uz|Ōta (Gunma)|vi|Ōta, Gunma|war|Ōta, Gunma|zh|太田市|zh_classical|太田市|zh_min_nan|Ôta-chhī|zh_yue|太田|qid=Q386179|lt=Ōta, Gunma}} in Gunma Prefecture. ===Railways===
* {{ill|Hachiōji and Ōme|ja|はちおうじ・おうめ|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q5366279}} – A limited express train operated by {{ill|East Japan Railway Company|en|East Japan Railway Company|qid=Q499071|lt=JR East}} on the Chūō Main Line, replacing the former home liner "Chūō Liner."
* {{ill|Hachiōji Station|en|Hachiōji Station|qid=Q800868|lt=Hachiōji Station}} – JR East station in Hachiōji City on the Chūō Main Line, also the terminus of the {{ill|Hachikō Line|en|Hachikō Line|qid=Q1372071|lt=Hachikō Line}} and terminus of the {{ill|Yokohama Line|en|Yokohama Line|qid=Q1369102|lt=Yokohama Line}}.
* {{ill|Nishi-Hachiōji Station|en|Nishi-Hachiōji Station|qid=Q500790|lt=Nishi-Hachiōji Station}} – A Chūō Main Line station in the same city, west of Hachiōji Station.
* {{ill|Kita-Hachiōji Station|en|Kita-Hachiōji Station|qid=Q844347|lt=Kita-Hachiōji Station}} – A Hachikō Line station in the same city, north of Hachiōji Station.
* {{ill|Hachiōji-Minamino Station|en|Hachiōji-Minamino Station|qid=Q844693|lt=Hachiōji-Minamino Station}} – A Yokohama Line station, two stops south of Hachiōji Station.
* {{ill|Keiō-hachiōji Station|en|Keiō-hachiōji Station|qid=Q906143|lt=Keiō-Hachiōji Station}} – A {{ill|Keio Corporation|en|Keio Corporation|qid=Q1332506|lt=Keiō Corporation}} station about five minutes' walk from JR Hachiōji Station.
* {{ill|Ise-Hachiōji Station|ja|伊勢八王子駅|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11378944}} – A {{ill|Kintetsu Railway|en|Kintetsu Railway|qid=Q1531085|lt=Kintetsu}} station that existed until 1974 in Hachiōji, Yokkaichi City, Mie Prefecture.
* {{ill|Hachiōji Line|ja|八王子線|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11391625}} – Such as the {{ill|Yokkaichi Asunarou Railway Hachiōji Line|en|Yokkaichi Asunarou Railway Hachiōji Line|qid=Q6414360|lt=Yokkaichi Asunarou Railway Hachiōji Line}}.
